descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/: Connect ATT&CK activity, deterministic rules, statistical anomaly types, and 175 security telemetry sources through a vendor-neutral reference atlas.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/adversarygraph-: Use the Docker-served reference book with exact technique links into activity, rule, anomaly, and telemetry sections from the AdversaryGraph matrix.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/attack-activity: Map suspicious and malicious behavior across Enterprise tactics to vendor-neutral logs that can provide evidence, while preserving observability limits.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/attack-basic-de: Build technique-level controls with exact matches, fixed thresholds, allowlists, state changes, and bounded correlations linked to required telemetry.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/attack-statisti: Explain ATT&CK-aligned behavior as measurable deviation from explicit baselines, with linked anomaly concepts, evidence sources, and CTI records.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/security-log-so: Explore 175 vendor-neutral telemetry types, what each records, and which security activity each can report without assuming a product or analytic method.
descriptions./anomaly-detection-atlas/statistical-ano: Use 118 definitions spanning point, temporal, distributional, graph, process, model, data-quality, and adversarial deviations with academic grounding.
